title: /privacy-policy/ pre-existing fidelity gaps: table <th> sizing + "cookie policy" link mislocation vs live
body:
Found while running the CORE-7279 (T13) bug-lane whole-page coord regression gate against
/privacy-policy/. NOT caused by T13 — confirmed by comparing the coord-live run BEFORE the T13
content/CSS fix landed against the run AFTER: these specific findings are byte-identical (same
px deltas) in both runs, so they predate T13's list-lettering fix and are unrelated to it.

## Defect 1 — table <th> sizing
Multiple table header cells (<th>) on /privacy-policy/ render at a different size on clone vs
live, consistently Δw=-25px Δh=-42px (and Δh=-12px at some breakpoints), repeating 3-6 times per
breakpoint. Likely a shared table-header style (font-size/line-height/padding) diverging from
live's table CSS — affects the "Purpose/Activity" table in Section 11 and the sharing-partners
table in Section 13 at minimum.

## Defect 2 — "cookie policy" link mislocation
The inline "Cookie Policy" link (Section 10, "Using automated technology" clause) renders
mislocated by 90-230px vertically vs its live position, present at all four breakpoints
(360/768/1024/1800) in both the pre-fix and post-fix coord runs.

## Evidence
qa-coord-live.ts runs, reports/T13-coord-live.json (T13's coord gate, both attempts) and
reports/T13-coord-live-raw-output.txt:
- @360 (pre-fix): [size] <th> Δw=-25px Δh=-42px (x4); [mislocated] <a> "cookie policy" 148px out of place
- @360 (post-fix, same magnitude): [size] <th> Δw=-25px Δh=-42px (x4); [mislocated] <a> "cookie policy" 230px out of place
- @1024 (both runs): [mislocated] <a> "cookie policy" ~104-127px out of place; <th> Δw=-25px Δh=-12px
- @1800 (both runs): <th> Δw=-25px Δh=-12px (x2)

prod URL: https://www.rapidformations.co.uk/privacy-policy/
clone URL (dev, used for the runs): https://localhost:3002/privacy-policy/

## What to do
1. Reproduce on /privacy-policy/ Section 11 "Purpose/Activity" table and Section 13's
   third-party-sharing table at 360/768/1024/1800 — measure actual <th> font-size/line-height/
   padding on clone vs live and diff against the table styling in TextContent.styles.ts's
   `policy.headerCell` rule (or wherever this page's table CSS lives).
2. Reproduce the "Cookie Policy" link mislocation in Section 10 ("Using automated technology"
   clause) — check whether it's a text-wrap/line-height issue on that specific inline link vs
   surrounding text, or a coord-tool matching artifact (verify by direct screenshot/DOM
   getBoundingClientRect measurement, not just the heuristic tool).
3. This is a fidelity gap (engine-first applies) — NOT a functional/behavioral bug, so route
   through the normal clone-fidelity pipeline rather than a Mode X bug lane.
